levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: «قال سألت هشام بن عروة»: حسان is the asker and transmits; Hisham is the one asked (rule 5)
«زاد حميد» is an addition by a co-transmitter already in the chain: not a second route
«كان عروة يقطعه» describes Urwa's action in the saying: not a link
«ثم ساق معناه» is a wording remark: left out
